page.layout: One page of text, single column, with headings and verse stanzas. Running head at top centre. Page number at top left. Handwritten annotations in both margins and at the foot are not printed and are not transcribed. Catchword at lower right.

main_text.head: Asylus infestus equis & tauris. A minimo hoste timendum.
main_text.p: Urget asylus equos ingentes, vexat & idem (Sit licet exilis) corpora magna boum. Viribus, ô confise tuis, ne tempseris hostem Securus: metuas sed licet exiguum.
main_text.head: Panoplia Christiani militis, ex Ephef.cap.6.
main_text.p: Dicitur, immani cùm vult pugnare draconi, Quò vincat serpens, arma parare sibi. Tu, Satanæ (quo non extat draco sævior alter) Qui pugnare paras, arma parata gere. Sit thorax circum præcordia tutus amoris: Spes aptet capiti tegmina firma tuo. Læua fidem teneat clypei septemplicis instar: Viua sit in dextra, Sermo, machæra, Dei. Ieiunúsque, vigilque preces adiungito, pigra Otia depellas: sis inopíque bonus. His, Satanam contra, si depugnaueris armis, Tela vibrabit iners, terga dabitque fugax.
main_text.head: Vetus & novus orbis.
main_text.p: Ecce nouo veteres homines gignuntur in orbe: Quàm vellem veteri sint vt in orbe noui! Hoc verò fiet, Christo si subditus vni Orbis adhærescens sit nouus atque vetus.
main_text.head: Vetus & Nouus homo. Allusio ad Interdictum de Noui operis nunciatione, ex lib. 36. Pandectarum.
main_text.p: Ecce nouum vicinus opus tibi nunciat: vltrà Romanum te ius ædificare vetat.

page.notes: Handwritten marginal annotations (left and right margins, and the large manuscript note at the foot) are not printed text and are omitted. The word "metuas" in the first emblem stanza is partly obscured by a stain and is uncertain. The word "de" before "Noui operis" in the last heading is partly overwritten by a stain.
